project.summary: Claude Code /rewind for DeepSeek Harness: git-first workspace snapshots before every mutating tool, turn-boundary session forks, and a one-shot /rewind command that restores files and forks the session back to a checkpoint.

release.changelog: 0.4.0: /rewind preview read-only impact preview, excludeGlobs glob semantics, path/argument safety hardening at the persistence boundary, npm publish workflow. Full history in CHANGELOG.md.

management.label: dsh plugin add dsh-checkpoint-rewind
management.instructions: Install with `dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-checkpoint-rewind` (npm) or `pnpm dsh web --patch ./cordis.patch.yml`, then restart the profile; /rewind becomes active in the Web UI.

declarations.permissions: Reads workspace files for snapshot capture; writes workspace files only on an approved /rewind restore (overwrite of captured files, never deletion, never through symbolic links). Writes snapshot storage only under snapshotDir. Runs only whitelisted side-effect-free git primitives. No network, no credentials.
declarations.testing: 160 unit tests (node --test) plus assembled-headless integration (copy and real-git flows); CI green on Windows/Linux x Node 22/24; npm package published as 0.4.0. Load-level verified against dsh 0.1.0-rc.6 (dsh plugin add, dump-config layer, inject activation; stripped headless profile lacks the storageDomain service).

capability.expected: the /rewind command is registered on the commands service: it lists checkpoints, restores workspace files after user confirmation, and forks the session at the checkpoint's turn boundary
